messages.subject: changing a single file; but having to publish all files
parts:
After initial deployment of a multi file app to shinyapps.io if I make  changes locally via RStudio only to one file what is the correct way to upload the changed file online?

Right now if I uncheck the other (not changed) files it seems to delete them from the online app which isn't what I want. 

OTOH if I check all files then it just uploads again even the unchanged files (I think)

Any suggestions?

messages.subject: Re: changing a single file; but having to publish all files
